rules.title: Rent control – rent ceiling
rules.requirement: Landlords may not charge rents above what they were receiving on the chapter's effective date, nor above what they received on January 11, 1973 if that excess is more than the chapter authorizes.
rules.coverage_text: Dwellings subject to Hoboken Chapter 155 (rent control); exemptions are not in this chunk.
rules.quoted_span: No landlord shall, after the effective date of this chapter, charge any rents in excess of what he was receiving from the effective date of this chapter; nor shall such landlord charge any rents in excess of what he was receiving on January 11, 1973, if such excess is in excess of the rental which is authorized by this chapter.
rules.key_value: Rent frozen at base rent except increases authorized by chapter

rules.title: Certificate of compliance required for regular rent increase
rules.requirement: A notice of regular rent increase must include a certification of substantial compliance with the building, housing, fire and property maintenance codes. Without it the notice is invalid and the tenant may refuse to pay the increase.
rules.coverage_text: Landlords of dwellings subject to Chapter 155 seeking a regular increase under § 155-5.
rules.quoted_span: The landlord may not charge or collect such rental increase if he has failed to provide any such certification, and, in such instance, the tenant may refuse to pay such rental increase without Board proceedings, though the tenant may file the notice with the Board for information.
rules.penalty: Increase notice invalid; Board may rescind increase and order amounts paid withheld from future rent if certificate inaccurate

rules.title: Inspector certification for capital improvement or hardship increases
rules.requirement: A landlord seeking a capital improvement or hardship increase must file a Division of Health inspector's certification of substantial code compliance with the application; no increase may be granted until filed.
rules.coverage_text: Landlords applying to the Board for capital improvement or hardship increases.
rules.quoted_span: No such increase may be granted until said certification has been filed.
rules.penalty: Board may deny application and rescind any increase granted if certification inaccurate

rules.title: Vacancy decontrol – 25% limit on initial rent
rules.requirement: On voluntary vacancy of a registered unit, the unit is decontrolled for the new tenant's initial rental, but that rent is limited to 25% over the last rent paid (excluding capital improvement surcharge). Later increases are subject to the chapter.
rules.coverage_text: Registered dwellings subject to Chapter 155 upon vacancy by a tenant.
rules.quoted_span: Provided that a dwelling is registered in accordance with § 155-30 upon the vacation of a residential apartment unit by a tenant, the apartment unit shall become decontrolled and exempt from the provisions of this chapter for the new tenant's initial rental; provided, however, that said rental shall be limited to an increase of 25% over the last rental paid by the tenant who voluntarily vacated the rental unit, exclusive of any capital improvement surcharge that is a component of said last rental.
rules.penalty: Board may rescind decontrol and prosecute under § 155-21 (§ 155-32)

rules.title: Vacancy decontrol limited to once per three years
rules.requirement: No dwelling unit may be decontrolled under the vacancy decontrol article more than once in any three-year period.
rules.coverage_text: Dwelling units subject to Chapter 155 vacancy decontrol.
rules.quoted_span: No dwelling unit shall be decontrolled pursuant to this article more than once in any three-year period.

rules.title: Condo/co-op initial rental decontrol
rules.requirement: When a bona fide condo/co-op owner-occupant vacates and rents the unit, the unit is decontrolled solely to set the initial rent, after which it is fully subject to Chapter 155.
rules.coverage_text: Condo/co-op units whose owner occupied them as principal residence for the previous two years.
rules.quoted_span: Said unit is decontrolled for the purpose of establishing the initial rental only and otherwise is fully subject to Chapter 155.

rules.title: COVID-19 temporary rent increase moratorium
rules.requirement: Rents and other charges (including surcharges, parking, pet fees, deposits) could not be increased from April 1, 2020 until May 7, 2022; deferred increases are prospective only, with 30-day notice.
rules.coverage_text: Tenants and properties covered by Chapter 155.
rules.quoted_span: The moratorium shall be made retroactive to April 1, 2020, and shall remain in effect until May 7, 2022.
rules.ambiguity_note: Moratorium expired 2022-05-07, so it is not in force as of 2026-10-01; 'failed' is used as the closest status for an expired rule.
